x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given a computer CI with a serial number, When a second source presents the same serial with a different name, Then the IRE updates the existing CI rather than creating a duplicate Given identification rules are reviewed, When the entries are listed, Then serial number is the highest priority identifier for hardware and computer classes
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: Identification rules for in-scope classes use serial number before name, FQDN or IP
